title: Drone strikes in the Kordofan's region
summary: In tonight's programme, 28 people were killed in drone strikes on a market in Central Sudan's Kordofan region. Our correspondent Tom Canetti sits down with Sanda Ojiambo, the Assistant Secretary General and CEO of the UN's Global Compact initiative. contentText: In tonight's programme, 28 people were killed in drone strikes on a market in Central Sudan's Kordofan region. Our correspondent Tom Canetti sits down with Sanda Ojiambo, the Assistant Secretary General and CEO of the UN's Global Compact initiative. And as Muslims around the world are gearing up for the start of Ramadan, the Islamic holy month is already inspiring many to give back to their communities...
